text: DSH Chat Navigator 是面向 DSH Web 的聊天导航插件，在页面右侧提供可展开的浮动面板。它从当前会话列出用户问题，也提供跨会话历史列表；打开问题列表可查看问题及后续回复预览，并点击定位到对应问题。列表按需加载较早内容，历史会话支持切换后跳转到目标问题。适合需要快速浏览长对话或回到旧会话特定提问的 DSH Web 用户。源码未显示额外密钥或外部服务配置。

DSH Chat Navigator adds a right-side panel to DSH Web for browsing questions, previewing replies on hover, and jumping to a selected question. Its history list opens older sessions and loads earlier questions on demand. It helps navigate long chats without extra keys or external services.
想在 DSH Web 里快速浏览当前对话问过哪些问题
能不能悬停问题时预览当时的回复
我想从会话历史直接跳回某个提问的位置
DSH Chat Navigator 的功能「问题导航与预览」：右侧面板列出当前会话的问题，悬停可查看问题及其后续回复摘要，点击条目可定位到对话中的问题。
DSH Chat Navigator 的功能「跨会话历史跳转」：面板列出最近更新的历史会话，点击会打开对应会话并尝试定位到其最近问题；问题列表按需请求更早内容。
dsh-chat-navigator 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 65 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-chat-navigator README · Install：Install the public DSH bundle into the Web profile:

dsh plugin --profile web add github:16512354554/dsh-chat-navigator

Restart `dsh web` after changing the profile, then open the chat-history button on the right edge of the conversation view.

dsh-chat-navigator README · Install：The package is a normal DSH bundle: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle`, and `cordis.patch.yml` mounts the browser client into the Web overlay slot. Installing a plugin runs third-party code with your user permissions; review the source before installing it.

dsh-chat-navigator README · Development：The repository keeps the generated `lib/` runtime artifacts required for GitHub installs and includes the TypeScript/CSS source under `src/`. The source is built against the DSH client contracts. To develop it inside a DSH checkout, copy or link this repository into `packages/client/ui-chat-navigator`, then run:

pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat-navigator run bundle
    pnpm exec vitest run packages/client/ui-chat-navigator/tests/navigator.client.spec.tsx
dsh-chat-navigator README · Development：The DSH package's client bundle is loaded through the host module loader; it must not be opened as a standalone browser application.
